text: Could your backyard be earning rent? LotFoundry shows you what your lot can do, in about a minute.
Start with your address. LotFoundry pulls your parcel, local zoning, and your area's market rents.
See what a backyard home could earn. On this Seattle demo lot, about two thousand and fifty dollars a month.
Then shape it. Place an ADU in 3D, right on your lot, and see whether it fits.
Check feasibility: an estimated build range, rent, and payback, plus what to verify before you permit.
LotFoundry. Find out what your backyard can do. Available now on Google Play.
